title: Push Delivery — Dead-Letter Record
description: One exhausted delivery, returned by GET /api/pact/{resourceId}/subscriptions/{id}/dead-letters (§21.3). Retained per the §15.1 retentionPolicy; readable by the subscription's owner only (for server-managed escalation-hook subscriptions, the Mandate's handler_principal_id). Added in PACT v2.1 (§21).

event_id.description: The §6.1 event id — the idempotency key the deliveries carried.

event.description: The undelivered event envelope, clearance-reduced per §17.13 at read time.

last_failure.description: Terminal failure classification: e.g. http-4xx, http-5xx, timeout, permanent-gone, ownership-challenge-failed.
